title: His Imperial Band and Rolf's Original Optimus Orchestra
summary: He names the members of his Stockholm band and the other traditional band he plays piano in.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well what band do you play with now? We're jumping around so much.
The band I play now is called Imperial Band. We've been playing for about three years.

I am the leader. But now I'm gone so now the Clarence player is the leader. It's not really... It's a leader. It's not really a leader in the band. Just everybody is a leader. The leader... The only thing with the leader is that he gets the jobs and pays the musics. That's the only... There's no musical leader at all. There's nobody saying now we play this tune.
Well who's in your band? What are the names of the people?

Well it's Christer Fellas on the trumpet. Yeah. And Orian Selin on the planet. Ralph Bandler, trombone. And Ingmar Wistrand, Banyo. I don't know what the new bass player is. They change bass player now. And drum is Chris Rolson.
Who was your bass player before?
He bass player. The last one we had him called Otter Sörman, which is a youngster just came. He had started playing a year ago. He was over in England all this summer.
Oh yeah. We should write these names down so we have the correct spellings later. Yeah. But it's so hard for me to understand. But there are other bands like yours that play on the style?

Right now it's just about, in Stockholm there's only two bands I would say who play this kind of music we play. I mean there are a lot of traditional bands, but most of them play more modern style. They play a type of Eddie Conner style, something like that, most of the bands. But we had only two bands, his imperial band is one called Original Optimus Orchestra, which Rolf plays in.

Yeah. He has the band. I'm playing piano with that band when I'm home too, because his piano player had left just about a year ago. I see. So I play in two bands. But he don't play often because, as I say, he's married. And then the guys in his band, they are a lot older than the guys in my band. They started out way before me. They are more involved in other things.
